title: A complex-analytic barrier and a driven charge-conserving attack have different scopes
statement: First,for0<g<1/4,the bounded-degree three-local chain A_n=sum N_i+g sum N_(i-1)X_i(I-N_(i+1)),with fixed endpoints,has a reducing domain-wall Jacobi block of energy spread DeltaE in[n,n+4g]. Onsite P=Z1 yields a nonremovable inverse-Pauli operator-log derivative pole z*=2pi i/DeltaE for n>=2. This excludes a volume-uniform JOINT complex-analytic/Taylor-Cauchy closure,not real-axis locality,positivity,other preparers or the ideal encoder;embedding into a nontrivial code reference is not proved. Second,a separately reviewed explicitly DRIVEN reference-charge-conserving protocol exploits preparation-noised thermal resource banks. Fixed gap set{0,Delta,2Delta},fixed-body energy-resolved contacts and compute-copy-uncompute predicates compile the virtual source;native two-body implementation is not proved. An O(log n)buffer and polynomial fresh banks/rare clean thermal workspace are charged at every fixed bath flip rateq>0,with q-dependent constants/exponents. Independent amplification adds random logical Pauli and isolated spent records,turning successful memory-only reduced branches entanglement-breaking;after polynomial attempts Bell infidelity>=3/8-o(1). Earlier inverse-polynomial rare-branch result and old uncleared-oracle wording remain history. Input is one logical qubit with syndrome-diagonal encoding;cleanest attack permits zero memory noise and nonzero resource-bath noise under per-site upper bounds,not necessarily identical nonzero rates everywhere. It does not attack static/autonomous same-H equilibrium retention or a receiver granted all discarded records.
